published_source: Published article (Management Science 70(12), 2024) Table 4 5 (Ln(1+male electrical engineers)); identical to the package's Output/Table 3.tex. Stata reghdfe re-run in the work directory: 0.130372 (0.038002), N = 10852; fixest with the pre-expanded controls: 0.130372 (0.038008).
notes: City x census-year panel 1910-1940 (2,713 cities, 48 states), cities with 1920 population <= 100,000. Treatment post_cutover = (census_year >= city's first dial cutover date), absorbing; cohorts by first treated census: 1920: 9, 1930: 111, 1940: 126 cities; 2,467 never treated by 1940 (90.9%); none treated in 1910; no switch-offs. Published regression ('Table 3, 4.do' line 206, unweighted): reghdfe y post_cutover, absorb(id year i.statefip##i.year c.ln_citypop##i.year) cluster(id). State-by-year FE enter as xt_vars statefip (t^statefip). The absorbed c.ln_citypop##i.year (log census-year city population with year-specific slopes) is pre-expanded into the four numeric controls ln_citypop, ln_citypop x 1(year=1920/1930/1940) (1910 base), which span the same space. Only violation of PROTOCOL Section 2: time-varying controls (5c).
